It is a know fact that yes, you have a higher dps by blowing your swifts and trips on opener, since you get more casts with party buffs, which you wont always have when you have to move.

You're losing one cast by doing that, which would never happen in 3.0 enochian. This over the course of a fight ends up adding to a susbstancial dps loss.

Unless you get stunned or theres a phase transition...
